title: fix(platform-objects): the sys_user page's Security tab shows only on the viewer's own record
body:
Fixes #24938

Clause-②: no (platform metadata only: the Security tab's self-service sections are shown on the viewer's own record only; no action, param, response, spec key or export moves)

## What changed

The `sys_user` record page's **Security** tab item (`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`) now carries an item-level gate: `visibleWhen: P` + "`has(record.id) && record.id == ctx.user.id`". This is the same `P` (CEL) envelope and `has()` guard that the page's unverified-email `record:alert` uses. On the viewer's own record, the tab is unchanged. On any other user's record, both the tab header and its panel are omitted. Nothing else moves: the actions and their own gates in `sys-user.object.ts`, the other tabs and the alert are all unchanged.

## Measured before the edit

- **Tab item `visibleWhen` is declared and honoured.**
  - Spec: `PageTabsProps.items[].visibleWhen` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, an `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema`). The docs say a FALSE gate omits the whole tab (header and panel), and that a child component's own `visibleWhen` "hides only the panel content and would leave an empty tab header behind".
  - Renderer, objectui at the pinned `.objectui-sha` `cf153eb2e535`: `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, `isItemVisible` in `PageTabsRenderer`. It calls `ExpressionEvaluator.evaluateCondition` (`packages/core/src/evaluator/ExpressionEvaluator.ts`), which sends an explicit `{ dialect: 'cel' }` envelope to the CEL engine. Bare strings stay on the legacy evaluator. The scope is `buildNodeEvaluationScope`: the ambient scope binds `ctx: { user }` (`packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx`), with `record` set to the row.
- **Component-node `visibleWhen` is honoured too.** `PageComponentSchema.visibleWhen` (`packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts`) is evaluated by objectui's `SchemaRenderer`. The alert above already relies on it.
- **The whole Security tab is self-service.** It holds four headed sections whose `record:quick_actions` name `change_my_password`, `change_my_email`, `enable_two_factor`, `disable_two_factor`, `generate_backup_codes`, `resend_verification_email` and `delete_my_account`. Each of those actions has a `visible` led by `has(record.id) && record.id == ctx.user.id` in `sys-user.object.ts`. Nothing in the tab serves an administrator. On another user's record, an administrator sees only the four headings and captions.
- **Choice: gate the tab, not the sections.** A per-node gate would leave an empty "Security" tab header on every other user's record. The item-level gate is the shape the spec documents for this case.
- **Pin census.** Before this change, no test asserted the Security tab's structure. `sys-user-details-tab.test.ts` pins only the first (Details) tab. `canonical-expression-envelopes.test.ts` covers every expression position on the page, and stays green with the new envelope.

## Pin

`packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user-security-tab-own-record.test.ts` asserts:

- the page parses through `PageSchema`;
- the Security item's `visibleWhen` equals `{ dialect: 'cel', source: 'has(record.id) && record.id == ctx.user.id' }`;
- Security is the only tab item that carries an item-level gate;
- every action the tab names exists on `SysUser` and is a pure conjunction (no `||`) led by the own-record guard. If someone later adds an administrator action to this tab, the test goes red, because gating the whole tab would hide that action.

**Ablation.** I deleted the `visibleWhen` line with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `c4dd9db6ae30` → `200f0d8d63f6`). The pin went red: 2 failed, 2 passed ("carries the own-record gate…" and "gates only the Security tab…"). After restore: blob == HEAD (`c4dd9db6ae30`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The test imports the page from `src/`, so no build or `dist/` leg is involved.

## Verification (head `0c2c418b8`, after merging `origin/main` `28c9a2cb6`)

- `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2`: 77/77 tasks, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: exit 0, Test Files 85 passed (85), Tests 1247 passed (1247).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`: exit 0, Test Files 6 passed (6), Tests 82 passed (82).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 66 lines, all run on this head, every one exit 0. Before the full build, three families exited 3 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:lean-entry-closure`); after it, all three exit 0. `--ran`: "66 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 66 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- Browser reading: not taken.

## Acceptance notes

- **Tab URL tokens shift on another user's record.** No item on this page sets `value`, so the renderer derives the `?tab=` token from the index in the FILTERED item list (`tab-INDEX`). On another user's record, hiding Security moves API Keys from `tab-9` to `tab-8` and Preferences from `tab-10` to `tab-9`. On the viewer's own record the tokens are unchanged. A `?tab=` link copied from your own record to someone else's can therefore open the tab after the intended one. The spec already recommends a semantic `value` for durable links. Giving the items one touches the other tabs, which this card leaves out of scope. Carrier: none.
- `#24277` is not addressed here. It cites this tab as precedent for a platform-default Settings tab.
